plugins.name: hyperspell-brain
plugins.description: The Hyperspell company brain — your organization's people, projects, decisions, and priorities, synced from Slack, email, Drive, Notion, GitHub and more.

plugins.name: hyperspell-activity
plugins.description: Keeps local work notes after working turns and writes one reviewable activity entry per repository and branch when work settles. Optional session handoff helps continue recent work after a new session or /clear. Visibility follows the share option: suggest (default) keeps each entry yours and asks before sharing, shared posts it to the company where the workspace allows that, personal never asks; with a workspace key every entry is the company's.
